summary: This directory provides standardized, reusable button interface components that wrap core UI library primitives, ensuring consistent behavior and visual presentation for user-triggered actions throughout the application.
responsibilities: Wrapping UI library button primitives to maintain consistent styling and behavior
Providing specialized button variants for common interaction patterns
Exposing documented component stories for development and visual testing
relationships: The Button component properties define the shared configuration for all button variants.
The FileUpload and Primary stories illustrate the practical usage and behavior of different button variants.
The Button index file facilitates centralized access to all button-related components and interfaces.
designDecisions: Use of component wrapping to encapsulate underlying library dependencies
Interface-driven development for consistent component properties
Component-driven development using storybook patterns for documentation and preview
